content_blocks.steps_heading: Your CAPM Certification Path in Centennial

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires only a secondary degree and completion of project management education hours—no prior work experience needed. If you hold a high school diploma or associate degree, you qualify. This makes CAPM ideal for career changers and early-career professionals in Centennial's aerospace, healthcare, and technology sectors.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's intensive, live-virtual instructor-led boot camp. Our instructors deliver the full curriculum online, allowing you to learn from anywhere while maintaining your current job. This format accommodates Centennial professionals' schedules without requiring relocation or commute time.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your education, apply directly to PMI and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy provides guidance throughout this step to ensure your application meets all PMI requirements and processes smoothly.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests and review sessions led by active certified practitioners. Our support continues right up to your exam date, ensuring you enter the testing center confident and ready.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM is valid for three years. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through ongoing learning, volunteer work, or formal training to renew your credential. Staying current keeps your qualification competitive in your field and demonstrates commitment to professional growth.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.
